description:
Configure the email notification settings in Jolly Lobby Track to alert employee hosts when visitors arrive. 

Navigate to the Settings or Options menu, locate the Email/Notification configuration, and enter the following SMTP details provided by IT:

- SMTP Server: mail.acmetech.com
- Port: 587
- Username: lobby@acmetech.com
- Password: NotifyGuests2024!
- Sender Email: lobby@acmetech.com
- Enable SSL/TLS: Yes
- Enable Host Notifications: Yes

Save the settings. Then, take a screenshot of the configured email settings screen and save it specifically to 'C:\LobbyTrack\email_config_evidence.png' (create the folder if necessary).
